lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: This is an automated message from the Telecom Regulatory Authority. Your mobile number will be suspended in two hours. Press 9 to speak to an officer.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, I am from TRAI legal department. A SIM card registered on your name was used to send obscene messages and for fraud.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I am forwarding your complaint to Mumbai police. Please stay on the line.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Mumbai police, Sub Inspector Pawar speaking. There are 17 complaints on your number. You need to give a statement on video.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Do not tell your family, they may be involved also. Keep your camera on.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Tell me the OTP you just received, it is to verify your identity with the court.
